description: WAANDA agent configuration for professional services deployment.

agents.purpose: Daily assessment of all active projects — health score, confidence, risks, blockers, recommendations.
Real-time monitoring of active client deliveries. Fires on SLA risk, milestone miss, critical risk.
Simulates 3 delivery scenarios (current / +1 resource / risk-adjusted) for each project.
Validates invoices, monitors overdue receivables, and supports collections escalation.
Drafts collections communications calibrated to relationship strength and overdue severity.
Qualifies leads, drafts proposal follow-ups, and detects pipeline velocity issues.
Weekly cross-department pattern recognition. Surfaces what worked in one department to expand to others.
